blind.description: A square raised flower bed bordered by two stacked courses of stylized grey masonry stones. Inside the stone retaining border is dark potting soil planted densely with low-growing stylized flowers and green foliage featuring bright red, vibrant orange, and golden-yellow blooms. The geometry is clean and cohesive in a stylized, hand-painted video game asset aesthetic, with flat-bottomed base sitting directly on the ground.
blind.from_above: A square stone-framed garden plot enclosing a lush square canopy of green leaves filled with scattered patches of red, orange, and yellow flowers over dark soil.
blind.height_vs_figure: The stone rim reaches roughly one-fifth of the figure's height (around 1.2 feet tall), and the square bed spans about two-thirds of the figure's height in width (roughly 3.5 to 4 feet on each side).
